First-order rate equations, or a stochastic population, for the competing decay routes give the lifetime, quantum yield, phosphorescent tail and Stern-Volmer line exactly; the model is small and honest, if close to a kinetics diagram, and the fluorophore lifetimes and yields are published facts.

Euler's rigid-body equations are three ODEs, integrated at interactive rates. The angular-momentum sphere with its energy curves is an exact geometric construction, and the flipping can be seen without reading anything.

A GOY or Sabra shell model has about 20 complex ODEs, runs easily in the browser and reproduces the -5/3 spectrum, so it is the honest reduced model at level 3. The spectrum needs time-averaging and a stiff-aware integrator, and the page must say it is a shell model, not Navier-Stokes.

Particles meeting at 1:1 with a limiting reagent is a small, honest agent model, and the leftover powder shows the result. The muffin and balloon second run is closer to a picture, and the page nearly duplicates fizz-and-balloons, so merge the two.

A 2D closed film under tension and inside pressure relaxes to a circle, and two bubbles form a flat wall (Plateau), so those parts are buildable. Why plain water fails and soap holds (Marangoni stabilisation) and foam drainage are not captured honestly by a spring mesh, so narrow the page to the least-surface shape.

Ideal-gas expansion of trapped bubbles gives only about 25% rise from room temperature to 100 °C. The real rise comes from CO2 release kinetics and steam, which the entry does not model. As described it is a step-through with threshold rules, close to a picture dressed as a model, and the oven-door collapse claim is shaky.

As described it is a step-through with a probe reading from a temperature table. The honest model of a diffusion flame (Burke-Schumann, wax evaporation and wicking) is above level 0 and is not what is proposed, so this is a browse-a-diagram. Faraday's text (Gutenberg #14474) is public domain, but data is not the issue.

Oxygen use as an ODE with an extinction threshold of about 16% O2, plus atom counting from the balanced reaction, is small and honest. Much of the page is step-through narration, and it overlaps fire-triangle almost entirely, so merge the two.

Evaporation as an ODE plus the published curve of boiling point against sucrose concentration is a real, tiny model, and the thermometer genuinely reads the water left. Mapping the candy stages to concentration is an honest lookup, and the data is published facts.

Threshold denaturation temperatures are published facts, so it is buildable. But the honest model needs heat conduction into the egg over time (time-at-temperature, first-order kinetics), not a dragged thermometer. The grey ring (iron sulfide) is not modelled.

Particles detach from a lattice at a temperature-dependent rate and random-walk up to a solubility cap: a clean, small agent model with a conserved count. It duplicates dissolving-sugar-and-salt, so merge the two.
The same honest particle model as dissolving-sugar, plus evaporation that recrystallises the solute, with a dozen handbook solubility values. Keep this one and fold dissolving-sugar into it.

A molecular box where Boltzmann-weighted fast surface particles escape, with humidity build-up and wind removing the vapour, is honest. Evaporative cooling emerges from the model and is visible on the thermometer.
The oxygen-depletion part is a real small model, but the water, wet-cloth and wick-cutting controls are rule toggles. It is nearly the same page as candle-under-a-jar, so merge them.

Stoichiometry with a limiting reagent, a rate law and an ideal-gas balloon volume, with the mass staying constant on the scale, is a small honest model. It duplicates baking-soda-and-vinegar, so keep one.

Henry's-law partition between drink and headspace, with a temperature-dependent constant and nucleation that rises with supersaturation, is a real small model. Constants are available from NIST WebBook (public domain) or Sander's compilation (ACP, Copernicus open access).

A lattice Monte Carlo with supersaturation-driven nucleation and growth honestly shows few big crystals from slow cooling and many small ones from fast cooling, and the solubility curves are published facts. The days-long timescale must be compressed openly.
A scrubbable scale with about twenty hover marks is a browse-a-diagram with no model behind it. The data (USDA FSIS, public domain) is fine, but no dynamics produce the takeaway.

A circuit model built from electrode potentials, a large internal resistance per lemon, series and parallel addition, an LED threshold and zinc consumption is small and honest. The model must not use the Zn/Cu Daniell 1.1 V, because the lemon's cathode reaction is hydrogen evolution, about 0.9 V.

Heat conduction into a kernel, steam-table pressure and a rupture threshold, with spread-out kernel properties for the pop-count curve, is a real small model. The two figures needed (about 180 °C, about 10 atm) are citable facts; the paper's full text is on HAL.

A grid automaton with wetness- and salt-dependent rates is buildable, but the relative rates are loosely sourced and the electrochemical mechanism is hidden. Anchor the rates to published corrosivity categories (ISO 9223) rather than invented numbers.

Equilibrium on the NaCl brine liquidus (FHWA table, US government public domain) plus an energy balance for heat of fusion is an honest small model. The bath dropping below 0 °C and freezing the cream emerges from it.

A rule-based particle sort through a chain of tools is honest at level 0 but closer to a puzzle state machine than a physical model. The chromatography strip could use real retention factors to give it substance.
Archimedes' equilibrium depth from a dozen published densities, with salt changing the water's density, is an exact, tiny, honest model, and the outcome can be seen directly.

Random walk plus advection in a room with walls is honest and cheap. The model must keep the real timescales, diffusion alone taking hours across a room, so that the draught's dominance is a true result.

A coarse-grained 2D bead model (DPD-like) with a few hundred particles can show oil coalescing and amphiphiles coating droplets at interactive rates, so it is honest. It is fiddly to tune into reliable micelles, and the virus step is a picture.
